name: flow-arc-diagram
title: Arc Diagram
description: An arc diagram: nodes in a row, sized by their total, with arcs for the links between them and a label under each node.

name: flow-chord
title: Chord Diagram
description: A chord diagram where ribbons between the nodes show how much flows each way.

name: flow-chord-directed
title: Directed Chord Diagram
description: A chord diagram whose links end in arrowheads, so each one shows its direction.

name: flow-chord-non-ribbon
title: Chord Diagram with Moving Bullets
description: A chord diagram with thin line links, nodes drawn as circle bullets, and a circle travelling along every link.
jsonNote: Giving each circle the color of its node takes code, so here they are all one color.

name: flow-sankey
title: Sankey Diagram
description: A Sankey diagram: nodes in columns and links whose width shows how much flows between them.

name: gantt-multilevel
title: Gantt Chart with Subtasks
description: A Gantt chart with parent tasks and subtasks, set up with parentId in the category data.

name: gantt-save-state
title: Gantt Chart That Saves Edits
description: A Gantt chart that keeps the user's edits and marked dates in localStorage and restores them on the next visit.

name: gantt-simple
title: Gantt Chart
description: A Gantt chart with a flat list of linked tasks.

name: gauge
title: Gauge with Clock Hand
description: A gauge made from a radar chart: a half-circle value axis and a clock hand that points at a value.

name: gauge-bands
title: Gauge with Bands
description: A gauge with labelled color bands, where the hand and the value label take the color of the band the hand is in.
jsonNote: Moving the hand and coloring it by its band take code.

name: hierarchy-force-directed
title: Force-Directed Tree
description: A force-directed tree: nested data as linked circles that arrange themselves and open on click.

name: hierarchy-pack
title: Circle Pack
description: A pack chart: nested data as circles inside circles, sized by value, where a click opens the next level.

name: hierarchy-partition
title: Partition Chart
description: A partition chart: every level of nested data as a column of rectangles sized by value.

name: hierarchy-sunburst
title: Sunburst Chart
description: A sunburst: nested data as rings of slices, one ring per level.

name: hierarchy-tree
title: Tree Chart
description: A tree chart: nested data as linked nodes laid out level by level.

name: hierarchy-treemap
title: Treemap with Breadcrumbs
description: A treemap that drills into a branch on click, with a breadcrumb bar to go back up.

name: hierarchy-voronoi-treemap
title: Voronoi Treemap
description: World population as a Voronoi treemap, with theme rules that style each level and a click that zooms to a continent.
jsonNote: Styling by level, names where they fit and the zoom on click take code, so this one shows country codes.

name: jest
title: Testing with Jest
description: A project set up to run Jest tests against a chart, in the jsdom environment.

name: json-config
title: Chart from a JSON Config
description: A pie chart built by passing a JSON config to JsonParser, with refs for its data and series.

name: map-altitude-arcs
title: Globe with Raised Arcs
description: Flight routes between cities on a globe, drawn as lines that rise above the surface in an arc with the altitude setting.

name: map-animating-along-lines
title: Animating Along Lines
description: A plane flies back and forth along a line between two cities, moved by the animations setting of its bullet.

name: map-auto-home
title: Map with Home Position
description: A map that opens zoomed in on Europe, using the home settings and autoHome, with a home button to return there.

name: map-clustered-points
title: Clustered Map Points
description: City markers that merge into clusters with a count when they are close together; clicking a cluster zooms in on its cities.
jsonNote: Zooming in on a clicked cluster takes code.

name: map-day-and-night
title: Day and Night Map
description: A world map with a NightSeries that shades where it is night right now and shows the sun.

name: map-globe-rotate-to-country
title: Globe Rotating to a Country
description: A globe that turns and zooms to the clicked country, and back when it is clicked again or the water is clicked: clickZoom on a map that pans by rotating.

name: map-globe-with-projected-circles
title: Globe with Projected Circles
description: Population by country as circles that lie on the surface of a globe and flatten towards its edge, sized by a heat rule, with surfaceBullets.

name: map-pixel-map
title: Pixel Map
description: A world map drawn as a grid of dots with PixelMapSeries, with countries colored by value using heat rules.

name: map-sankey
title: Map Sankey
description: Flows between countries drawn as bands on a map with MapSankeySeries, each band as wide as its value.

name: map-sankey-waypoints
title: Map Sankey with Waypoints
description: Oil routes on a globe: MapSankeySeries flows between coordinates, bent through waypoints to stay at sea, with a bullet travelling along each one.
jsonNote: Giving every drop the same speed and its own start takes code, so here they all take the same time.

name: map-satellite-day-and-night
title: Satellite Day and Night Map
description: A flat map that shows a daytime satellite image where the sun is up right now and city lights where it is night, with MapRasterSeries. The images load from the amCharts CDN, so it needs an internet connection.

name: map-satellite-globe
title: Satellite Image Globe
description: A slowly turning globe that shows a satellite image with MapRasterSeries, with country borders drawn over it. The image loads from the amCharts CDN, so it needs an internet connection.

name: map-surface-bullets
title: Globe with Surface Bullets
description: City pins that lie on the surface of a globe and flatten towards its edge, using the surfaceBullets setting of MapPointSeries.

name: map-us-heat-map
title: US Heat Map
description: US states colored by value on a red, yellow and green scale, with heat rules and a heat legend that take several colors.

name: map-with-bubbles
title: Map with Bubbles
description: Bubbles placed on countries by their id, with heat rules setting each bubble's size and color from its value.

name: map-zoom-to-country
title: Zoom to Country
description: Click a country to zoom in on it; click it again, the water or the home button to zoom back out. One setting, clickZoom, does it.

name: misc-chart-element
title: Chart as an HTML Element
description: The <am5-chart> element builds a chart from a JSON config, with no root and no chart code: for pages, frameworks and tools where writing chart code is not the point.

name: misc-microchart-grid
title: Micro Charts in a Table
description: A table with a tiny line chart and a tiny column chart in every row, each in its own root with the Micro theme.

name: pie-chart
title: Pie Chart
description: A pie chart with a legend below it.

name: pie-donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: A pie chart made into a donut with an inner radius, with a legend below it.

name: pie-variable-radius
title: Pie Chart with Variable Radius
description: A pie chart where each slice's radius follows its value, set by an adapter on the slice template.

name: radar-date-range-columns
title: Radar Date Range Columns
description: Rounded radar columns that span date ranges on a circular date axis, with a ring for each category.

name: radar-heat-map
title: Radar Heat Map
description: A heat map on a radar chart, hours around the circle and weekdays as rings, with a heat legend that shows the value of the hovered cell.
jsonNote: Showing the hovered cell's value on the legend takes code.

name: radar-line
title: Radar Line Chart
description: A line series with bullets on a radar chart, with a category axis around the circle and a cursor.

name: radar-time-line
title: Radar Timeline with Slider
description: Radar columns that animate through the years with a play button and a slider, and continent ranges that zoom in when clicked.

name: sliced-funnel
title: Funnel Chart
description: A funnel series in a sliced chart, with labels on the slices and a legend.

name: sliced-pictorial-stacked
title: Pictorial Stacked Chart
description: A pictorial stacked series: slices fill an SVG shape in proportion to their values.

name: sliced-pyramid
title: Pyramid Chart
description: A pyramid series in a sliced chart, with aligned labels and a legend.

name: stock-chart
title: Stock Chart
description: A stock chart with candlesticks, volume, a scrollbar with a preview, a legend and a toolbar for indicators, periods, series type and drawing.

name: stock-chart-comparing-stocks
title: Comparing Stocks
description: A stock chart with a comparison control and a searchable dropdown: picked stocks are added with addComparingSeries() and the chart switches to percent change.

name: stock-chart-data-granularity
title: Stock Chart Data Granularity
description: A stock chart with an interval control that swaps minute, day, week and month data and sets the matching base interval on the date axis.

name: stock-chart-data-grouping
title: Stock Chart Data Grouping
description: Three years of daily prices on a date axis with groupData, which shows them as weekly candlesticks when zoomed out and as daily ones when zoomed in.

name: stock-chart-live
title: Live Stock Chart
description: A candlestick chart that gets a new price every second: the last candle is updated or a new one is added, and an axis range follows the current value.

name: stock-chart-volume-separate-panel
title: Stock Chart with Volume Panel
description: A stock chart that shows volume in a second panel, which has its own axes, legend and cursor and stays in sync with the main one.

name: svg-renderer
title: SVG Renderer
description: A column chart drawn as SVG instead of canvas, by choosing the renderer when the root element is created.

name: timeline-linear-process-diagram
title: Timeline on a Custom Path
description: A day as a timeline that follows a hand-made path: a curve chart whose axis runs along a list of points, with an icon pin on every activity.

name: timeline-serpentine-chart
title: Serpentine Timeline
description: A serpentine chart: tasks as columns along a date axis that winds back and forth, with a circle at each end of a task and flags for events.

name: timeline-spiral-chart
title: Spiral Chart
description: A spiral chart: three years of monthly values as columns along a date axis that winds outwards, with a value axis across it.

name: venn-diagram
title: Venn Diagram
description: Three overlapping circles and their intersections, with a legend.

name: wordcloud-with-data
title: Word Cloud from Data
description: A word cloud made from a list of words with weights, colored by weight with a heat rule.

name: wordcloud-with-text
title: Word Cloud from Text
description: A word cloud made from a paragraph of text: the series counts the words and sizes them by how often they are used.

name: xy-100-percent-stacked-column
title: 100% Stacked Column Chart
description: Stacked columns shown as shares of each category's total, using valueYShow and calculateTotals.

name: xy-bubble
title: Bubble Chart
description: Countries as bubbles on two value axes, sized by a heat rule and colored per data row through templateField.

name: xy-candlestick
title: Candlestick Chart
description: Daily open, high, low and close prices as candles on a date axis; OHLCSeries takes the same settings.

name: xy-clustered-column
title: Clustered Column Chart
description: Several column series side by side in each category, with value labels and a legend.

name: xy-column
title: Column Chart with Date Axis
description: A column series of daily values on a date axis, with a cursor, a scrollbar and zoom.

name: xy-comparing-periods
title: Comparing Two Periods
description: This period as a solid line and the previous one as a dashed line on the same dates, with one tooltip showing both values.

name: xy-data-grouping
title: Data Grouping on a Date Axis
description: A line of 50,000 hourly values that stays responsive because the date axis groups them into longer periods with groupData.

name: xy-draggable-range
title: Draggable Range
description: A handle on the date axis that the user drags to move an axis range; the part of the series after it is drawn in another color with a pattern fill.

name: xy-drawing-series
title: Drawing a Series
description: Clicking the plot area adds a point to a line series and its bullets can be dragged, by turning pointer coordinates into axis values.

name: xy-dumbbell-plot
title: Dumbbell Plot
description: A range per category drawn as a thin column from the open value to the close value, with a bullet at each end.

name: xy-gapless-date-axis
title: Gapless Date Axis
description: A line of weekday values on a GaplessDateAxis, which leaves out the weekends so the points stay evenly spaced.

name: xy-line
title: Line Chart with Date Axis
description: A line series on a date axis, with a cursor, a scrollbar and zoom.

name: xy-line-highlight-on-legend-hover
title: Highlight Line on Legend Hover
description: Ten line series with a legend at the side; hovering a legend item dims all the other lines, done with events on the legend item template.

name: xy-live-data
title: Live Data
description: A line that gets a new point every second and drops its oldest one, with the new point animated in from the last.

name: xy-multiple-synced-value-axes
title: Multiple Synced Value Axes
description: Three line series with a value axis each, colored like their series, with the grids lined up by syncWithAxis.

name: xy-percent-change-comparison
title: Percent Change Comparison
description: Two price series shown as percent change from the start of the zoomed range, so they can be compared, with a volume panel on a second, stacked Y axis.

name: xy-pulsing-last-bullet
title: Pulsing Last Bullet
description: A line whose last point has a pulsing bullet, switched on for one data item with templateField and animated with the animations setting.

name: xy-real-time-data-sorting
title: Real-Time Data Sorting
description: Columns whose values change on a timer and that slide to their new places as the category axis is sorted again.

name: xy-smoothed-line
title: Smoothed Line Chart
description: A smoothed line series with a fill and bullets on a date axis.

name: xy-stacked-and-clustered-column
title: Stacked and Clustered Columns
description: Column series where some are stacked and some start a new cluster, set per series with the stacked setting.

name: xy-stacked-column
title: Stacked Column Chart
description: Six column series stacked on a category axis, with value labels and a legend.

name: xy-stacked-step
title: Stacked Step Line Chart
description: Two step line series with fills, one stacked on the other, on a date axis.
